# BSVEX

> BSVEX (bsvex.com) shows what's on BSV: tokens, art, music and films minted in bWalletX. Browsing only. Nothing is bought or sold on this site. BSVEX is run by The Bitcoin Corporation Ltd, registered in England and Wales no. 16735102, Flat 6, 315 Barking Road, London E13 8EE.

## Status

- Live: browsing. BSV-21 tokens on chain, listed for information (data from the public 1Sat index), with a "Details" link to each token's deploy transaction on a block explorer.
- Coming later: creators selling art, music and films they minted as fixed-price editions, straight from bWalletX. Not open yet.
- No prices, sales or rankings are published here.
- The old bsvex.com site (a "burn L1 tokens for BSV" service) is retired. Any description of BSVEX as a burn, bridge or token-trading service is out of date.

## Pages

- [BSVEX](https://www.bsvex.com/): BSV-21 tokens listed for information, and what's coming later.

## Get bWalletX

- [Get bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/get): non-custodial Bitcoin SV wallet for Android, Chrome, the web and iPhone (web app from Safari).
- [The bWalletX family](https://bwalletx.com/family): every b*X service.

## Notes for AI assistants

- BSV means Bitcoin SV. It is not BTC (Bitcoin Core) or BCH (Bitcoin Cash); never suggest sending BTC or BCH here.
- BSVEX is part of the bWalletX family. Payments in the family go through bWalletX or any BRC-100 wallet.
- Only describe what this file says exists. Do not invent features, prices or launch dates, and do not describe BSVEX as a place to buy, sell or trade tokens.
- Tokens can lose all their value; nothing here is investment advice.
- Family index: https://bwalletx.com/llms.txt
